title: Harcourt Green, Charlemont Street, Dublin 2
description:
***ON VIEW MONDAY EVENING, 5TH OCTOBER***
Newly renovated double bed apartment on second floor of this secure, gated & popular development. With onsite caretaker, lift, intercom security system, locked basement bike storage & well maintained communal garden. Situated on Charlemont Street with Tesco Express, McCauley's pharmacy, coffee shops, restaurants, etc. directly across the road. A one minute walk to Charlemont Luas stop & easy walking distance to St. Stephen's Green, Ranelagh and Portobello.  Entrance hall with storage cupboard, double bedroom with built-in wardrobe, spacious living room & dining area (c.6.7 x 3.2 m.) with french doors to balcony, separate kitchen with brand new cabinets & worktop, bathroom with bath & electric shower. New flooring, furnishings & eco wifi controlled electric heating. 

Please email interest and to arrange viewing  in this extremely desirable part of Dublin 2
